result.instructions: Tools for Courier, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which messages failed to deliver in the last day, and why?"; "Show the delivery history for message 2c1f3e…, channel by channel."; "Send the order-shipped template to user_1042 with the tracking link in its data.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Courier data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run courier_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run courier_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run courier_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. courier_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: courier_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List recently sent messages, newest first, with status, recipient, channel and provider. Filter by status, event, list, recipient, tag or enqueued_after. Paged by cursor. GET /messages.

status.description: Filter by message status (repeat values allowed).

provider.description: Filter by provider key (repeat values allowed).

enqueued_after.description: Only messages enqueued after this value, as the API defines it.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's paging.cursor.

tools.name: courier_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: Get one message by id (the requestId returned by courier_send_message), with its delivery status and provider. GET /messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: courier_get_message_history
tools.title: Get message history
tools.description: Get the delivery history events for one message (status changes per channel). GET /messages/{message_id}/history.

type.description: Optional history filter type, as the API defines it.

tools.title: List notification templates

template_id.description: The notification template id (nt_...) or its alias.

tools.name: courier_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: Send a notification from a template to one recipient, a list or a tenant. Courier routes it to the channels in the template. Sends real messages. Pass an idempotency_key to make retries safe. Returns a requestId. POST /send.

email.description: Email address (used when the profile has no user_id).

list_id.description: Send to every subscriber of this list.

tenant_id.description: Send to every user of this tenant.

to.description: Who receives the message: set one of user_id, email, phone_number, list_id or tenant_id.

template.description: Template id (nt_...) or alias to send.

brand_id.description: Brand id to use instead of the template's brand.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key, such as a UUID, reused only for a retry of the same send.

tools.name: courier_cancel_message
tools.title: Cancel a message
tools.description: Cancel a message that is queued or scheduled and not yet delivered. POST /messages/{message_id}/cancel.

tools.name: courier_subscribe_user_to_list
tools.title: Subscribe a user to a list
tools.description: Subscribe one user to a list, with optional per-topic preferences. Idempotent: subscribing again updates the subscription. PUT /lists/{list_id}/subscriptions/{user_id}.

preferences.description: Per-topic channel preferences, as the API defines them.

annotations.title: Subscribe a user to a list

tools.name: courier_unsubscribe_user_from_list
tools.title: Unsubscribe a user from a list
tools.description: Remove one user's subscription from a list, so the list no longer sends to that user. DELETE /lists/{list_id}/subscriptions/{user_id}.

annotations.title: Unsubscribe a user from a list

tools.name: courier_invoke_automation
tools.title: Invoke an automation
tools.description: Run an automation template for one recipient, with data. The automation sends its messages. POST /automations/{templateId}/invoke.

profile.description: Profile fields to use for the recipient.

tools.name: courier_track_event
tools.title: Track an event
tools.description: Send a track event for one user, tied to a message id, so journeys and automations can react to it. Records a real event in the workspace. POST /inbound/courier.

message_id.description: The message id this event relates to (any id you choose if none).
